⚠️ Le “tonique” français (astringent, à base d’alcool) c’est pas du tout la même chose que le toner coréen — c’est même l’opposé. Le toner coréen, c’est fait pour recharger la peau en eau, pas pour l’assécher. Quand je suis arrivée en France il y a 6 ans, je cherchais mon toner partout — et je le trouvais pas. Et ce qui m’a encore plus choquée, c’est que mes amies françaises n’en utilisaient pas du tout. Pour elles, c’était pas une étape. Moi, j’oublie parfois ma crème. Mais mon toner ? Jamais. 💛 #skincare #kbeauty #astucepeau #toner #skincarecoreen

I’m so proud to work alongside such an extraordinary team at AWL. Together, we were able to perform a surgery that had never been done before and give one very special boy the future he deserved. Thank you to everyone who supports AWL—whether you donate, foster, volunteer or simply share our stories. And it’s GONE!!! They were so amazing, we did numb the hand off camera but they were super comforting around my anxiety. I remember one of the comments from you guys on my past videos saying to advocate for myself and let the doctors know about my anxiety and to ask for any accommodations.  The doctor was so great , she gave me a little stress ball in the shape of a heart 🥹❤️ and she got some cold spray to put on my hand (which did help a little) and the assistant tapped my leg to distract me as well. For the shots I kept thinking to myself that - if I have gotten shots in my mouth before (a very sensitive space mind you) at the dentist, I could definitely do my hand. I was trying to give my brain evidence that we have done some similar before and that it turned out okay. And anytime it hurt, I just sang a little extra louder 😣 they were so supportive.  This was a huge step from a few weeks ago, when I went to the doctor and had a panic attack in their office when they said they wanted to draw my blood. I’m still very afraid of that, but I’m taking little steps at a time! Especially if I want to start a family and go through pregnancy, I want to get more comfortable with needles. #procrastination #needles #dermatalogy #mole #cyst
